claim: disrobe devirtualizes real IronBrew2 2.7.0 obfuscator output back to runnable Lua whose execution under the real Lua interpreter matches the original, in both standard and MAX mode.
gate_source: IronBrew2 2.7.0 is the one Lua VM-devirtualization family graded on committed output from the real obfuscator. The real-Lua execution differential runs the recovered output against the original across hello, arith, control, tables, and edge samples in standard and MAX mode.

oracle.external: real Lua interpreter execution differential (recovered output executed under real Lua, asserted equal to the original)

title: Lua IronBrew2 2.7.0 devirtualization, real-Lua execution differential
